text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men. Because the position was awarded to another man, there is no viable basis for alleging sex discrimination or unfair disadvantage based on gender. 

While an all-male panel may reflect broader diversity or representation shortcomings within the municipality's leadership, it did not work against you on the basis of sex. Raising the panel's gender composition would be unfounded, distract from legitimate questions about qualification criteria, and potentially harm your professional reputation. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback, focusing strictly on how the panel evaluated qualifications, interview performance, and priorities such as public consultation experience.
